4.4.4 An applicant's name, country of birth, accent or language background must not influence any score. 4.1.2 For the Payroll Officer role (E1), only experience in which the applicant was responsible for processing payroll counts towards the minimum period. Processing payroll means calculating wages and running pay cycles, not only checking or entering data.
